checks_run.actual: The product diff is 5 files: RulePage.tsx, problems.json en/ar (one key), the z14 unit test, and ADR-0051 part B. There is no API, schema, migration or contract change. The docs/delivery diff is round-11 records, the FE-Z16 handback, assignment and evidence, V15, decisions, findings and stages. The stale refusal is thrown only in resolveRestrictedTokens on the version PATCH (versions.ts:510 and its retired-form branch), and RulePage EditContent is the only web caller. The Arabic is labelled provisional in ADR-0051, as for the other automation_rule restricted-token texts. That keeps automation explainable and traceable to the configuration a person approved, and it meets REQ-S12-019 and REQ-S20-013 (the A13 suites are green). D-205: a rule disabled now stops its pending events. The residual commit-order race documented in ADR-0043 can only run an action of a rule a person had enabled, never a business approval (REQ-S12-026 refuses human-only actions), so it is acceptable as documented. D-235/D-236: repairing rather than accepting an untrue text was right, and the repair is verified (F-DG6-700 CLOSED_VERIFIED). No new finding.
